youtube.title: Why Elevators Have Mirrors 🪞 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Early tall-building elevators were slow, and tenants complained constantly about the wait. Instead of buying faster machinery, building managers installed mirrors in the cars. People started checking their appearance, the wait felt shorter, and the complaints dropped. Mirrors also help wheelchair users see behind them when reversing out.

Subscribe to The Hidden Why for a new why every day.
